title: Trader Diary: BTC at $75,892
content:
📈 9:00 PM: Spot buy the dip, whisper “HODL forever”.
⏰ 9:05 PM: Leverage 20x, eyes on the 1‑minute chart, heart rate 180 BPM.
🪦 9:07 PM: BTC flatlines, I’m suddenly a philosopher about “price is what you make it”.
lesson: If your heart rate spikes more than the price, scale back the leverage.
question: Who else turned a 2‑minute dip into a 2‑hour therapy session? Drop your best “I should’ve listened to my mom” story 👇
